items.title: Skilled Independent
items.desc: No state commitment. No nomination required. Purely points-based. Best for profiles at 90–100+ points. Often run in parallel with the 190.

items.title: Regional Pathway
items.desc: +15 points from regional nomination. Much less competition. Leads to 191 PR after 3 years in regional Victoria. Worth serious consideration for ICT profiles at 75–85 points.

items.title: Employer Sponsored
items.desc: Bypasses the points queue entirely. If you have 1+ year of experience and a willing employer, this can be the fastest route to PR without ever needing a competitive points score.
